title: Etale multiplicative degree-two cohomology equals Galois cohomology
statement: For every field K, H²_G(Ks^×) [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology] is in bijection with H²(Spec(K)_et,G_m), the cohomological Brauer group [def-br].

proof.text: The homogeneous continuous cochain model is naturally equivalent in degree two to the quotient of continuous inhomogeneous two-cocycles by continuous one-cochain coboundaries.
The stalk equivalence of abelian etale sheaves with discrete continuous Galois modules identifies degree-two etale cohomology of the units sheaf with the explicit inhomogeneous cocycle quotient.

proof_origin.document: Stacks Project, Etale Cohomology, Lemmas 04JQ and 03QU, Example 03QV (2), Section 0DVG
proof_origin.place: The homogeneous/inhomogeneous change of variables and stalk comparison
